newsitem.title: THAILAND: Sacked official named on Thai central bank board.
newsitem.headline: Sacked official named on Thai central bank board.

text.p: Thailand's cabinet on Tuesday approved a finance ministry proposal to name a sacked deputy governor of the Bank of Thailand, Ekamol Khiriwat, on its 11-member board, official spokesman Varathep Rattanakorn said.

Ekamol, who also concurrently was head of the Securities and Exchange Commission, was sacked from the two positions by then Finance Minister Surakiart Sathirathai on charges of leaking insider information.
But a criminal court late last year dropped the government charges against him after his accusers were unable to bring enough witnesses and evidence to prove their charges.
"I appointed him to help me in the field of stocks and financial markets," Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan told reporters after the cabinet meeting.
